name: own-pr-shepherd
description: Own-PR shepherd pass: lists the owner's open non-draft PRs in the configured repos (paged to the end, never a --limit cut-off), classifies each by its next step and drives it: fix requested changes, request a reviewer, merge the base in, fix CI this PR broke, enqueue an approved PR where the base has a merge queue. Run hourly by the schedule-crons `own-pr-shepherd` entry. Config-only manifest: OWN_PR_SHEPHERD_REPOS (empty = the current checkout's repo), OWN_PR_SHEPHERD_AUTHOR (empty = the signed-in gh login).
